title: Environmental applications of metal–organic framework-based three-dimensional macrostructures: a review
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,2208-2245
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00435C, Review Article
Cheng Chen, Liguo Shen, Boya Wang, Xinchun Lu, Saleem Raza, Jiujing Xu, Bisheng Li, Hongjun Lin, Banglin Chen
The latest advancements in MOF-based three-dimensional macrostructures, encompassing fascinating characteristics, preparation strategies, characterization methods, and environmental applications, are examined.
